title: Incremental token-latency heatmap + failover playbook and SLI plumbing
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: build a low-noise, token-granular SLI pipeline and a companion dashboard that ties token-latency behavior to regional circuit state and automated failover actions. This ticket covers instrumentation, sampling strategy, dashboard buildout, and a short operational playbook for interpreting hot-path token regressions during multi-region incidents.

Background: Our current region-level p95/p99 traces miss input-length and token-position patterns that precede cascading admitshed load-shedding. We need a sliding-window token SLI that preserves signal for short/high-frequency regressions (microbursts) while remaining cost-efficient for long-tail analysis.

Scope:
- Add a streaming aggregator that emits incremental token latency metrics: token_index, model_variant, route, shard_region, latency_ms_bucket, admission_state, circuit_state. Use 1s and 10s micro-aggregation windows and a 5m rollup for dashboards.
- Implement adaptive sampling: full capture for 0.5% of requests (tagged synthetic + production shadow) and summary histograms for 10% of requests. Sampling knobs exposed via feature flag for immediate throttle in high-cost scenarios.
- Produce a heatmap dashboard that shows token-index vs latency bucket per region/model variant; overlay circuit breaker states and recent failover events.
- Wire SLI derivation to alerting: p99 token-sli (sliding 5m window) and token-drop-rate thresholds mapped to runbook severity levels.
- Create a concise runbook/playbook page with triage checklist and mitigation steps (scale capacity, enable progressive admission hysteresis, reduce request batching, fallback to cheaper model variant).

Non-goals: full sequence-level decoding instrumentation (separate ticket), KV-cache internal timings (owned by runtime infra), long-term cold-storage of full token traces (>30d).
acceptance_criteria: Streaming token SLI emitter is live in canary region and emits expected fields to telemetry pipeline
Dashboard shows token-index heatmap across two regions and lets user filter by model_variant and route
Synthetic probe harness exercises 3 length cohorts (short/med/long) and is configurable from console
Alerting rule fires on token-p99 regressions with a documented runbook link
Sampling feature flag exists and can be toggled without service restart
